summary: Conviction under IPC s.302/149 based on circumstantial evidence; prosecution failed to establish complete chain of circumstances; motive of dowry unproven; cordial relations indicated; no complaint of ill-treatment; possibility of accidental death not ruled out; concurrent findings of lower courts set aside due to lack of conclusive evidence; standard of 'must be' guilty not met.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction set aside; appellants acquitted.
